name: Lifesize
description_en:
Lifesize currently appears within Enghouse Video as a cloud conferencing and meeting-room product family. Its former product URL redirects to an Enghouse Lifesize page; this identity transition matters when evaluating older prices or support instructions.

Lifesize Cloud offers meeting clients and virtual meetings, while Icon room hardware and Connect Plus Gateway address meeting-room equipment and interoperability. These should not be treated as one universally included cloud subscription.
description_zh:
Lifesize 当前是 Enghouse Video 旗下的云会议及会议室产品系列。原产品网址跳转到 Enghouse 的 Lifesize 页面，评估旧价格或支持说明时需注意这一身份迁移。

Lifesize Cloud 提供会议客户端和虚拟会议，Icon 会议室硬件及 Connect Plus Gateway 则处理设备与互通，不能视为任意云订阅都一并包含。

core_features.name_en: Cloud meeting clients and guest access
core_features.name_zh: 云会议客户端及访客加入
core_features.explanation_en: The vendor documents mobile, desktop and web applications and no-download guest joining in Chrome, Edge and Safari.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商说明移动、桌面和网页应用，以及 Chrome、Edge、Safari 的免下载访客加入。

core_features.explanation_en: Room-system and Connect Plus Gateway offerings bridge supported meeting environments; hardware scope needs confirmation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 会议室及 Connect Plus Gateway 方案连接支持的会议环境，硬件范围需确认。

en: An IT owner inventories the room hardware, firmware, invited meeting platform and cloud account. Demonstrate guest joining from a supported browser, room audio/video and content sharing before standardizing invitations. The cloud page describes recordings and up to 500 guests per call, but does not establish that every purchased tier includes that capacity or recording entitlement.

sections.title_en: Example: a hybrid team with an existing Icon room
sections.title_zh: 示例：已有 Icon 会议室的混合团队
sections.en:
An IT owner inventories the room hardware, firmware, invited meeting platform and cloud account. Demonstrate guest joining from a supported browser, room audio/video and content sharing before standardizing invitations. The cloud page describes recordings and up to 500 guests per call, but does not establish that every purchased tier includes that capacity or recording entitlement.

A room joining a Lifesize meeting and a room joining an external platform through a gateway are different acceptance paths. Test both relevant paths, including a failed join and an unavailable device; no room or guest session was tested here.
sections.zh:
IT 负责人应盘点房间硬件、固件、邀请中的会议平台及云账户。统一邀请方式前，演示受支持浏览器的访客加入、房间音视频和内容共享。云页面介绍录制及每次通话最多 500 位访客，但未确立所有采购层级都包含此容量或录制权。

房间加入 Lifesize 会议，与经网关加入外部平台是不同验收路径。应测试相关路径，包括加入失败和设备不可用；本次没有实测会议室或访客会话。

sections.title_en: Quote the cloud, hardware and support separately
sections.title_zh: 分别确认云、硬件及支持报价
sections.en:
The current official contact page provides product inquiries and separate support links. No public numeric price was established in the read sources. Request cloud licences, endpoint/room counts, hardware, gateway access, installation, support and replacement terms as explicit line items. Do not reuse historical per-host prices or assume a hardware purchase includes perpetual cloud service.

Confirm recording storage/retention, guest capacity, PSTN geography and any separate platform subscription. A vendor demo invitation is not a free production licence. No software licence grant or open-source rights were verified.
sections.zh:
当前官方联系页提供产品询问及单独支持入口。已读来源没有确立公开数字价格，应把云许可、终端/房间数、硬件、网关访问、安装、支持和更换条款列成明确报价项。不要复用历史每主持人价格，也不要假定购买硬件即永久包含云服务。

需确认录制存储/保留、访客容量、电话接入地域及单独平台订阅。厂商演示邀请不等于免费生产许可。本次未核实软件许可授权或开源权。

sections.title_en: Suitable evaluation depends on the room estate
sections.title_zh: 是否适合取决于会议室设备
sections.en:
Teams preserving a room-equipment investment can assess Lifesize alongside its cloud and gateway requirements. An organizer needing only an occasional browser call should compare the actual subscription and support scope before buying room infrastructure. Enghouse’s separate contact-center and other video brands do not automatically become Lifesize features.

Firmware compatibility, SSO configuration, encryption claims, media quality, regional availability and support recovery remain vendor/account validation tasks. The official redirect supports source attribution to enghousevideo.com; it does not prove every old Lifesize plan remains on sale.
sections.zh:
希望保留会议室设备投资的团队，可结合云及网关要求评估 Lifesize。只需偶尔浏览器通话的组织者，应先比较实际订阅与支持范围，再决定是否购买房间基础设施。Enghouse 的其他联络中心或视频品牌不会自动成为 Lifesize 功能。

固件兼容、SSO 配置、加密主张、媒体质量、地区可用性和支持恢复仍需厂商/账户验证。官方跳转支持将来源归属于 enghousevideo.com，但不能证明所有旧 Lifesize 套餐仍在售。
